uncertainties.note: Resource 6062 (rows 2139-2208) is legacy ACE2 material: pursuit of Gato's Gundam Unit 2 after the nuclear strike on the naval review, with per-unit banter sets (Uraki 2151-2165; others 2166-2187 incl. a UCE reference and a Dragonar-style 'kid'), cutscene lines 2191-2196 and developer placeholders 2197-2208. Translated faithfully; probably unused in ACE3.
'yatsu' rendered 'him' (Gato is male per Gundam wiki); the source word itself is gender-neutral and could also mean the machine.
Objects/subjects omitted; 2147 uses 'it' (target, cf. 2149 and batch 1506 precedent), 2150 left subjectless.
Recurring 'watashi wa gi ni yotte tatte iru' rendered 'For I stand on a righteous cause!' to avoid lowercase j ('justice'); longest of these is 2170 at 93 visible chars.
Banter sets 2166-2170, 2171-2174, 2175-2180, 2181-2183, 2184-2187 are per-unit alternatives; opposing pilots are untagged and were not identified (no names in the text).
One sentence split across two boxed rows; 2179 starts lowercase on purpose. 'waga taigi' rendered 'my great cause' (could be 'our').
2191 idiom 'gaishuu isshoku' paraphrased. 2192 'nido to wasuren' has no object (in 0083 Gato says it of Uraki); object not supplied.
'dasshutsu wo' could be 'eject' or 'withdraw'; 'get out of there' covers both.
Placeholder source is ungrammatical; read as 'Gato strongly acknowledges the pilot'.
Resource 6070 (Mission 07, Getter Robo Armageddon). Speakers untagged: 2209-2211 fleet commander, 2212 someone confronting Saotome (likely Hayato), 2213-2214 Saotome - none asserted in text.
